items.title: Add checkpoint-ledger replay for autopilot M1 resume
items.context: Implement M1 only: committed done checkpoints are replayed from a per-run ledger/snapshot boundary so resume can distinguish committed work from interrupted work. storyFilesHash is a frozen pre-run baseline excluding declared outputs.

happy.desc: A valid checkpoint ledger with committed done steps replays to a next pending step without re-dispatching done checkpoints.

edge.desc: A corrupt run snapshot can be recovered from the ledger projection when the ledger is valid and fresh.

adversarial.desc: Conflicting or stale checkpoint material fails closed instead of claiming a safe resume.

verificationEvidence.note: autopilot-resume smoke passed after 2da692dde and asserted resume projection skips committed done checkpoint iteration-0 without dispatching a new worker.
autopilot-resume smoke corrupted run.json and verified resume recovered a valid projection from checkpoint ledger snapshot evidence.
autopilot-resume smoke verifies stale checkpoint, maxIterations policy digest drift, and missing git freshness probes all fail closed instead of returning resume_ready.

items.title: Re-enable autopilot_resume for healthy non-stale runs
items.context: Replace the current hard refusal path with M1-safe resume semantics: refuse stale or corrupt state, but allow a healthy non-stale run to resume from the ledger-backed committed checkpoint projection.

happy.desc: A healthy non-stale AutopilotRunRecord no longer returns refused/unsafe_state from autopilotResume.

edge.desc: An actually stale run is still refused as stale_state.

adversarial.desc: A paused or unsafe terminal state cannot be turned into a successful resume claim by caller metadata.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke verified a healthy non-stale AP-green run returns status=resume_ready with remainingSteps=0 after preserving frozen producerRuntimeInput.
Smoke verified stale updatedAt, maxIterations validityPolicyDigest drift, and unavailable git freshness probes return refused/stale_state.
Existing autopilot-run smoke verifies cancelled resume still returns refused/unsafe_state and all resume outputs keep authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false.

items.title: Add Autopilot M1 resume smoke coverage and second-host validation
items.context: Add a focused smoke test that proves the red repro turns green, stale/unsafe cases still fail closed, committed done checkpoints are not replayed, and Antigravity/agy can independently review the evidence.

happy.desc: npm build and autopilot-resume smoke pass on the implemented code.

edge.desc: The smoke covers stale refusal and corrupt/conflicting ledger behavior, not only the green path.

adversarial.desc: Agy second-host validation confirms the result without using Claude CLI.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:autopilot-resume-smoke && node packages/main/dist/tasks/autopilot-run-smoke.js
verificationEvidence.note: Build, new package script smoke, and existing autopilot-run smoke all passed after 0eddf8fba.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-ownership-contract && node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs && lattice scope_contract_check {"storyId":"B-c7e2"}
verificationEvidence.note: Command ownership, process fact registry, and scope contract checks passed; resume wording stays aligned and scope gate remains pass.
Antigravity/agy second-host validation previously returned VERDICT: pass; after reviewer fixes, local tests added policy-drift and missing-freshness fail-closed coverage for the exact high findings.
